title: Question - How to compile and obtain the apk file?
body: I would help to improve the french translation for xDrip+, but I don't know how to compile and get the apk file (in order to test my changes). Could someone explain how to do it? Thank you :)

comments.body:
To get the code start with:
git clone https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip.git

From here I think that the simplest way will be to install android studio, and let it compile it. (file open and point to that directory).

A different way, is to write "gradlew build" in the root directory, but if you did not compile any android program on your computer you will have to install an sdk.

The AndroidAPS Wiki has a guide how to build AndroidAPS with Android Studio.
http://androidaps.org

You can basically do the same with xDrip in this repository.
Thanks, it works! I had to downgrade from java 9 to java 8.
